name: web-orlina-introducing-hero-alternate-crop-with-model-cards
title: Orlina 'Introducing' hero, alternate wide crop with trending filter pills and product cards
whatItIs: The same warm-toned Orlina hero as the primary case (model in a brown leather coat over a giant faint wordmark) shown in a slightly different crop with 'Trending Now' filter pills (Formal, Man, Woman, Kids) fully visible and floating product cards for Man, Women and Kids to the right.
whatItMeans: Same idea, wider view; useful for seeing how the filter row and product cards sit beside the hero.
techniques: Keep filter pills visible above a full-bleed hero.
Float category cards along one edge.
Reuse a hero across crops for responsive variations.

vocabulary.definition: A rounded button for narrowing a category.
The same design shown at a different crop or size.
